caption: A large, wet canvas is twisted to remove excess paint, leaving drips down the side.
conditions: first frame, caption, existing requirements; no future target
physical_dependency_analysis:
OBSERVED: Two figures seated before a large vertical white backdrop; no canvas, paint, or twisting motion visible. Unknown: whether the backdrop is canvas, whether it’s wet, or if any twisting will occur.

INTERACTION: If canvas were present and wet, twisting would initiate paint removal via friction and gravity; drips would form only if paint is viscous and gravity acts unimpeded.

PERSISTENCE: Drips would persist only if paint remains on the canvas and gravity continues to act; cessation occurs if canvas is dry, paint is removed, or motion stops.

INTERVENTION: Absence of wet canvas or paint → no drips or twisting. Presence of obstruction → drips cease or deform. Pressure inconsistency → uneven paint removal.
